name: Tiruchirappalli

queries.query: திருச்சிராப்பள்ளி நில அளவை பதிவேடு நகர நில அளவை TSLR FMB நில வரைபடம் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ e சேவை
queries.scope: Find city-specific town-survey land records and a safe anonymous full-vector map endpoint.
queries.result: The Tiruchirappalli District Administration Tamil land-services page links the state e-services for Patta/FMB/Chitta/Town Survey Land Register extracts and identifies the Survey and Settlement Department at the Tiruchirappalli Collectorate. The city corporation’s official planning page describes a local Town Survey Section staffed by survey officers and field assistants; it does not advertise parcel-vector downloads or a GIS feature service.
queries.executionMethod: Tamil-language search and inspection of the district Tamil service page and city corporation Town Survey description; no survey numbers or record values were submitted.

queries.query: Tiruchirappalli official urban cadastral parcel map TSLR FMB city survey GIS public viewer
queries.scope: Cross-check the local registry jurisdiction and whether the advertised service returns full public geometry.
queries.result: The English district land-service page links Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR extracts and lists the local Survey and Settlement Department. The official city corporation identifies a Town Survey Section responsible for survey work and land-dispute support. These are city-local record and survey services; no anonymous vector endpoint or feature schema was advertised. The linked Tamil Nadu e-services shell timed out in this environment, so no provider-down claim is made.
queries.executionMethod: English-language search plus direct public GET to the district page and a bounded GET attempt to the linked state e-services homepage; no land-record lookup was submitted.

coverageAssessment: City-specific TSLR/FMB and local survey services are confirmed. The WUP point was not resolved to a survey parcel and no full public vector geometry was returned.
registryBasis: The district administration explicitly offers urban TSLR extracts and FMB/land records and identifies the district Survey and Settlement Department; the city corporation confirms a local Town Survey Section. This establishes city-specific survey records, not an open geometry feed.
technicalBlocker: The linked public state portal did not return an HTTP response in this environment, and the local pages advertise extracts and administrative survey services rather than a public parcel-vector endpoint. No property details or owner fields were submitted.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the linked e-service provides a downloadable urban sketch for a known, non-sensitive survey number and whether any vector response exists are unverified. Current district content links only to record/extract workflows.
nextStep: If an anonymous published vector or documented full-geometry route becomes available, test it on a small bounded area; keep TSLR/FMB extracts separate from open parcel geometry.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
